proof_body:
by
  intro a p q x ha hpq
  have e : a * (x - p) * (x - q) = (-a) * ((x - p) * (q - x)) := by ring
  have hA : 0 < -a := neg_pos.2 ha
  have h1 : 0 < a * (x - p) * (x - q) ↔ p < x ∧ x < q := by
    rw [e, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hA, mul_pos_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h2 : 0 ≤ a * (x - p) * (x - q) ↔ p ≤ x ∧ x ≤ q := by
    rw [e, mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hA, mul_nonneg_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · exfalso
        linarith
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← not_le, h2, not_and_or, not_le, not_le]
  · rw [← not_lt, h1, not_and_or, not_lt, not_lt]
